hero.title: Claims fail on paperwork. We fix the paperwork.
hero.body: ClaimSathi reads your policy, checks every bill and photo for what insurers reject, and builds a claim you can send today, in Hindi or English.

health.name: Health and accident
health.a: Finds missing stamps, signatures and doctor registration numbers
health.b: Adds up every bill so totals match
health.c: Writes the claim letter for your insurer or TPA

crop.name: Crop (PMFBY and state schemes)
crop.a: Counts down the 72 hours from the moment of damage
crop.b: Checks your field photos carry location and time
crop.c: Follows the claim from survey to bank credit

read.title: Upload your policy once
read.body: A photo or PDF is enough. We pull out what's covered, what isn't, the limits and the deadlines, with the page each one came from.

check.title: Add bills or field photos
check.body: Every document is checked for what gets claims rejected, and you're told exactly how to fix each problem before you send.

track.title: Send, then follow it
track.body: Get a ready letter and checklist. Then see each stage, the date the insurer must act by, and what to do if they're late.

footer.disclaimer: ClaimSathi helps you prepare and track claims. It does not file claims into insurer systems, does not give legal advice, and cannot promise that a claim will be approved.
